title: East Texas's Most Unique Property? Historic Hotel Could Be Yours - NewsBreak
text: You’ve never seen a property like this in East Texas , much less had the chance to own it. This is 540 El Paso Street, deep in the heart of Jacksonville, Texas. This unique boutique/hotel/residence is on the market. READ MORE: The People Who Own The Most Land in Texas Featuring historic character and modern updates, the hotel offers eight guest rooms, a welcoming gathering space, a dining area, a breakfast bar, a full kitchen designed for group use, a dedicated treatment room, a sauna, and a large pool with a bar and an attached hot tub. The interior features real hardwood floors and carefully selected fixtures and finishes throughout. Many of the rooms are quirky and eccentric, yet beautiful and compelling. The house/hotel features 8 bedrooms, 6.5 bathrooms, a 4-car garage, and over 6,000 square feet of livable space. The property is listed at $975,000. The property is the home of the Hotel Ritual . It’s a wonderful bed & breakfast that offers numerous on-site therapeutic packages. Guests are welcome to add on healing treatments , such as massages, facials, aura glow, Shirodhara (an ancient mind-body reset originally from India), sound bath, yoga, and even music treatments with Dr. Parkingstine. There can be several attractive opportunities for the right buyer or investor. Taking over the property as a private residence or perhaps transitioning the hotel/boutique to something different. The seller is also open to a lease-back arrangement after the sale, offering flexibility for the buyer. Contact Hunter Townsend with Verse Realty for details about this fantastic listing and opportunity. Let’s take a look inside this amazing property.
